# Alex Leung

> Personal website and writing archive by Alex Leung, a software engineer, writer, and licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.).

## Site Map

- [Home](https://alexleung.ca/): Alex's software engineering work, education, writing, and interests
- [Now](https://alexleung.ca/now/): a dated snapshot of what Alex is reading and studying
- [Writing](https://alexleung.ca/blog/): essays, technical notes, book notes, and personal reflections
- [Contact](https://alexleung.ca/contact/): ways to reach Alex and follow new writing

## Writing

The blog covers software projects, AI tools and workflows, technical books, and personal notes on moving, travel, study, and life outside work.

## Background

Alex's software work has spanned embedded systems, distributed systems, AI product development, and full-stack product engineering. His previous work includes home electrification, AR/AI hardware, and consumer finance.

He holds a Master of Science in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Georgia Institute of Technology and a Bachelor of Applied Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of Waterloo. He is a licensed Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) through Professional Engineers Ontario.
